ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisites will be enforced. This section will open to all students in the College of Business and to Food Science & Human Nutrition majors on Monday, November 17, 2014 and to Technical Systems Management and ISE students on December 1, 2014 at approximately 9:00 a.m. There are currently 5 reserved seats for College of Business international exchange students; any unused seats will be released to students meeting the restrictions on Friday, January 23, 2015 at approximately 9:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor admitted prior to January 2013.
